correctness.rationale: Single-agent S5 truth at a world is determined by its atom type t and the equivalence-class type support S; modal-depth-one support indicators χ_S and atom tests realize every map F(S)⊆S, and distinct maps are witnessed by finite S5 classes. Uniform semantic equivalence therefore gives independent uniform choices F(S) over 2^S and count 2^(m 2^(m−1)). Repeated truthful world-deletion follows monotone orbits; extinction of all classes iff no nonempty fixed support. Recursion e_n=2^(-n)∑_{U proper S}e_|U| gives 1/2 for each fixed S; independent fixed-support indicators give product P_m=∏_j(1−2^(-j))^C(m,j) and its PGF. Log series −∑_{r≥1}[(1+2^(−r))^m−1]/r gives first two terms and O((9/8)^m) remainder. Independently exhaustively enumerated m=1,2,3 (2,16,4096 maps), matching all probabilities and universal counts 1,3,189; k=2,m=4 exact count follows product, not exhaustive enumeration.
